An approval that belongs to another Revision is not an expressible state. Moves to DD-1's mixed variants.

No listed product writer can create it: nir1_entity_relation_revision_prepare builds every Entity with exactly one Evidence from the live Codex row (build_live_typed_bundle: the summary, or the name when the summary is blank), so a typed Revision without Evidence cannot be prepared. Moves to DD-1's mixed variants (and the output check that no partial group is rendered).

The reason cannot be derived uniquely: the A2 reader checks the live Sources and the anchor projection (validate_live_sources) before canonical Freshness (read_typed_canonical_freshness), and after X1-3 the events that make a version-2 Revision's edges pending (the anchor's scene-scope event, scope-registry, Codex writes) come only from writes that also move the projection or the Codex source token, so the request would answer source-revision-changed; body, title and display saves do not make version-2 Revisions pending. A Freshness-only state is not reachable by the listed writers. Moves to DD-1's mixed variants.

The reason cannot be derived uniquely, for the same reason as P-08 freshness-not-evaluated (every listed write that stales a version-2 Revision's Freshness first fails the Source or projection check, read as source-revision-changed). Moves to DD-1's mixed variants.

No product writer changes a typed Revision's own binding: a Revision is immutable and nir1_entity_relation_revision_prepare always creates a new run, proposal set and proposal, so the only expressible revision change is the next stage's newly prepared Revision, which every P-10 variant already has. Moves to DD-1.

No listed product writer changes a version-2 Revision's Freshness without also changing its Codex source token or its anchor projection, and A2 then answers source-revision-changed before it reads Freshness, so the binding cannot be told apart from the source and scope variants. Moves to DD-1.

setupContract.audience: DP-H harness only. The scorer and the contract validator do not read `setup`, `setupContract` or `steps`; they are bound by the freeze record because they are part of the fixture bytes.
rules: Run each variant in its own workspace (workspace namespace = isolation.workspaceId + '/' + variantId).

Each case has one anchor Scene and one query Scene; the anchor is listed first so it precedes the query in reading order (A3 needs reading_rank(anchor) < reading_rank(query)). Every positive Revision anchors the case's anchor Scene, so a stage has one anchor projection token. An unknown-scope reject variant also declares its own negative-anchor Scene in `setup.scenes` (DR-DPH-106); only its negative is prepared there, and that Scene exists only in that variant's workspace.

Order inside a stage: case.setup writes (project, tree, Scope, Codex) and the variant's own codexEntities first; then the steps in the listed order. A stage-2 `binding-change` is the only write after the first prepare of stage 1; it precedes the first prepare of stage 2.

Every prepare/approve/write goes through the product writer (receipt.mjs EVENT_KIND_WRITERS): prepare = nir1_entity_relation_revision_prepare, approve and decision-cancel = narrative_extraction_append_human_decision, codex-update = codex_update, scene-scope-registry-update = narrative_scene_scope_registry_update, scene-scope-unknown = narrative_scene_scope_update with compatibilityMarker unknown and the three query-identity axes unresolved (reason = unresolvedReason) on the negative's own negative-anchor Scene only. No direct DML.
A reject variant's own negative is prepared, approved, then invalidated before any positive Revision is prepared (prepare-negative < approve-negative < invalidate-negative < first prepare).
Chat sessions are created with the renderer's createSession statement (node_id = the query Scene) before the profile is restricted; one per stage.
The user message of the case is the captured human message of every stage.

A placeholder `{{kind:logicalId}}` resolves from the setup receipt: runtimeId = idMap runtimeId (project, Scene, Codex Entity); revisionId/proposalId/decisionId = idMap rows of the Revision; revisionToken/sourceToken = runtimeValues rows. After X1-3 the revisionToken `<case>-anchor-projection` is the anchor Scene's Scene Scope projection token (not the project Scope authority revision).

runtimeValues are listed only for the stages whose positive expectations name them (a reject request has no template). Read a runtimeValues row after the stage's last write and invalidation and before its capture; it is never read from a request's output.

writers.projectAndScenes: project_create for the case's own project; tree_node_create with a single-paragraph ProseMirror body; the Scene body text is the Raw
writers.sceneScope: narrative_scene_scope_registry_update (registry first), then narrative_scene_scope_update for every Scene
writers.codex: codex_create (type, name, summary), codex_update for a summary change
writers.route: write_ai_settings: provider openai-compatible, one loopback endpoint (no request is sent), customMaxContext and customMaxOutput from `route`, model from `route.model`
writers.prepare: nir1_entity_relation_revision_prepare { projectId, sceneId: the anchor Scene, entityIds: [the Entity], relationIds: [], proposalKey }

setupContract.scopeNotes: Every Scene (anchor and query) gets the same explicit Scope. `addTimelineRef` adds that reference to the registry only; the registry write advances every binding's version, so every Scene's projection token moves and every typed Revision prepared before it is no longer eligible (source-revision-changed).

decisionPayload.cancel: a single human cancellation: decision `rejected` on a revision whose only Decision is `approved`

setupContract.evidenceRule: A prepared Entity's Evidence quote is the Codex summary verbatim (the name when the summary is blank). Summaries are non-blank, trimmed, single-line, BMP-only and contain no JSON-escaped character.

scenes.body: 春先、養蜂家の一家は山の斜面に巣箱を運び上げた。

scenes.title: 其の八 分蜂の朝
scenes.body: 巣箱の並ぶ斜面に朝日が届くと、蜂の唸りが一段と高くなった。末娘は面布を下ろし、群れが離れていく枝を見上げた。

scenes.body: 冬のあいだ、巣箱は土蔵の奥で藁に包まれて眠っていた。

scenes.body: 製本所の二階では、折り子たちが黙々と紙を畳んでいた。

scenes.title: 其の十三 始発の点検
